description: This file defines methods for handling cluster events in the Mattermost platform, including registering handlers, processing messages, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: RegisterClusterHandlers
methods.description: Registers various cluster message handlers for different cluster events.

methods.name: RegisterClusterMessageHandler
methods.description: Associates a cluster event with a message handler.

methods.name: ClusterPublishHandler
methods.description: Handles cluster publish events by decoding the event and publishing it.

methods.name: ClusterUpdateStatusHandler
methods.description: Handles cluster update status events by decoding and caching the status.

methods.name: ClusterInvalidateAllCachesHandler
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation requests from the cluster.

methods.name: clusterInvalidateWebConnSessionCacheForUserHandler
methods.description: Invalidates web connection session cache for a specific user.

methods.name: ClearSessionCacheForUserSkipClusterSend
methods.description: Clears session cache for a user locally and skips cluster notification.

methods.name: ClearSessionCacheForAllUsersSkipClusterSend
methods.description: Clears session cache for all users locally.

methods.name: clusterClearSessionCacheForUserHandler
methods.description: Handles cluster message to clear session cache for a user.

methods.name: clusterClearSessionCacheForAllUsersHandler
methods.description: Handles cluster message to clear session cache for all users.

methods.name: clusterBusyStateChgHandler
methods.description: Handles server busy state change events.

methods.name: invalidateWebConnSessionCacheForUserSkipClusterSend
methods.description: Invalidates web connection session cache for a user.

methods.name: InvalidateAllCachesSkipSend
methods.description: Invalidates all caches locally without notifying the cluster.

methods.name: InvalidateAllCaches
methods.description: Invalidates all caches and notifies the cluster.
